source.text:
Conservation readiness is not dispatch approval. The museum registrar must separately approve any departure for an external loan.
An emergency move within the museum may precede approval only with two handlers, continuous location tracking, and same-day registrar notification. This exception does not authorize external departure.
The conservation pilot covers training replicas only, never accessioned objects. The appropriate treatment for undocumented adhesive is unknown; do not infer permission to apply it.
